/api/partner/1.0/{product}/print (POST)
Endpoint authentication
When adopting OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method:
The user must fulfill the following security role requirements to trigger this endpoint. If he or she fails to obtain access to all the necessary security roles, a 403 error,
Insufficient privileges to execute this request
, is returned:
The user must be granted with at least one of the following security roles. He or she must have access to the security role corresponding to the product included in the URL:
Tax â Access T1 Product
Tax â Access T2 Product
Tax â Access T3 Product
Tax â Access Forms Product
In addition, the user cannot print documents to PDF without access to the security role below:
Tax â Returns â Print to PDF
The user cannot send documents to the Documents module if he does not have access to the security role below:
Documents â View and Upload
The user cannot change the print options found in the âPrint optionsâ modal without access to the security role below:
Tax â Returns â Print options
The watermark âDo Not Submit/Ne pas produireâ will automatically be applied if the user doesnât have the following security role:
Tax â Returns â Print/Publish without Enforced Watermark
This endpoint validates against the userâs
contact security
and
document visibility
. If the user does not have access to the document provided in the request body or the contact associated to this document, an
error 306: Resource not found in the system
is returned.
Endpoint description
This endpoint prints a batch of documents to PDF for the product and year specified in the URL of the endpoint. The user is also able to send a copy of the documents to the Documents module.  Once the print is initiated, a taskID is provided in the response location header and the status of the task can be retrieved by using the
Tasks endpoint
.
Model
Properties
{
"documents": [
{
"returns": [
{
"id": 0,
"language": "string",
"jurisdictions": [
"string"
]
}
],
"documentId": "string"
}
],
"options": {
"mergePdf": true,
"printFormats": [
{
"id": "string",
"copyToDocuments": true
}
],
"overridePrintedDate": "string",
"maskSinHeaderFooter": true,
"maskSinForms": true,
"changeReturnStatus" : true
}
}
documents:
Array of documents and IDs
documentId:
ID of the document to print
returns:
Array of taxpayer IDs
id:
ID of the taxpayer within the document (0 for main taxpayer, 1 for spouse and 1000+ for dependants). This parameter is optional and will default to 0 if not included.
language:
Language to use for printing the return. This parameter is optional and will default to the language of correspondence of the contact if not included.
jurisdictions:
Jurisdiction to use for printing the return. This parameter is optional and will, by default, print all jurisdictions applicable for the return. Available jurisdictions are Federal (FED), Quebec (QC) and Alberta (AB).
options:
Options related to the print job.
printFormats:
Array of IDs of the print formats to use to print
id:
ID of the print format
overridePrintedDate:
Overrides the printed date on the forms. This parameter is optional and will default to the current date if not included.
copyToDocuments:
Indicates if a copy of the return printed using the print format should be sent to the Documents module. It is optional in the payload, and, if not set, will fall back on the default setting defined in the print format. When copyToDocuments is set to true or false in the payload, the system automatically gives priority to the Web API and overrides the default.
Please note that this property can only be used if the user is logged into the Web API using the OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method. For more information on this authentication method, please
click here
.
mergePdf:
Parameter used to merge the PDFs into a single PDF. This parameter is optional and will use the default set in the
Customize PDF File
section of the site if not included.
maskSinHeaderFooter:
Parameter relevant for the T1 product only. It is used to mask the first five digits of the SIN in the header and footer. This parameter is optional and will use the default set in the
Customize PDF File
section of the site if not included.
maskSinForms:
Parameter relevant for the T1 product only. It is used to mask the first five digits of the SIN in the forms. This parameter is optional and will use the default set in the
Customize PDF File
section of the site if not included.
changeReturnStatus:
Parameter allowing to choose if the return status should automatically be changed after printing. This parameter is optional and will use the value set in
Return Statuses
section of the site if not included.
Examples
Request URL
https://mysite.cchifirm.ca/taxcan/api/partner/1.0/T1/print?returnManagerYear=2020
Request body
{
"documents": [
{
"returns": [
{
"id": 0,
"language": "English",
"jurisdictions": [
"FED",
"QC"
]
}],
"documentId": "221e7400-8d38-432e-a3ac-c988dfc6dc05"
}],
"options": {
"mergePdf": true,
"printFormats": [
{
"id": "373b860e-fd62-2a30-df89-6717e18e74c9",
"copyToDocuments": true
}],
"overridePrintedDate": "2021-04-20",
"maskSinHeaderFooter": true,
"maskSinForms": true,
"changeReturnStatus": true
}
}
Response body
N/A
Notes:
A maximum of 20 documents can be included within a single request. Including more than 20 documents will result in an error.
In the firm settings, the options set on the
Customize PDF file
page, such as the PDF nomenclature, are used for printing via the Web API.
The user chooses the returns to print and the application determines which jurisdiction(s) are applicable to those returns. If the return is applicable to a jurisdiction, the print will include the relevant forms related to this jurisdiction.
The print features via the Web API for the T1 and T2 products are supported starting from
CCH iFirm Taxprep
Pro T1 2019 and
CCH iFirm Taxprep
Pro T2 2017. Printing a document prior to those years will result in an error.
/api/partner/1.0/{product}/documents/{documentId}/printslips (POST)
Endpoint authentication
When adopting OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method:
The user must fulfill the following security role requirements to trigger this endpoint. If he or she fails to obtain access to all the necessary security roles, a 403 error, Insufficient privileges to execute this request, is returned:
The user must be granted with at least one of the following security roles. He or she must have access to the security role corresponding to the product included in the URL:
Tax â Access T1 Product
Tax â Access T2 Product
Tax â Access T3 Product
Tax â Access Forms Product
In addition, the user cannot print documents to PDF without access to the below security role:
Tax â Returns â Print to PDF
The user cannot send documents to the Documents module if he does not have access to the security role below:
Documents â View and Upload
The user cannot change the print options found in the âPrint optionsâ modal without access to the security role below:
Tax â Returns â Print options
This endpoint validates against the userâs
contact security
and
document visibility
. If the user does not have access to the document provided in the request body or the contact associated to this document, an
error 404: Requested endpoint not found
is returned.
Endpoint description
This endpoint prints to PDF the slips of a document specified in the URL of the endpoint. The user is also able to send a copy of the slips to the Documents module. The T3 or TF product must be included in the URL. Once the print is initiated, a
taskID
is provided in the response location header and the status of the task can be retrieved by using the
Tasks endpoint
.
Model
{
"options": {
"mergePdf": true,
"copyToDocuments": true
},
"form": "string",
"dataType": "string",
"language": "string"
}
Properties
form:
Name of the form for which to print the slips. Click
here
for the list of forms supported for this endpoint.
dataType:
Data type of the slips to print. (Original, Amended, Cancelled)
language:
Language to use for printing the return. This parameter is optional and will default to the language of correspondence of the contact if not specified.
options:
Options related to the print job
mergePdf:
Parameter used to merge the PDFs into a single PDF. This parameter is optional and will use the default set in the
Customize PDF File
section of the site if not specified.
copyToDocuments:
Parameter that allows the user to send a copy of the printed slips to the Documents module. This parameter is optional and will be set to False by default. Please note that this property can only be used if the user is logged into the Web API using the OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method. For more information on this authentication method, please
click here
.
Examples
Request URL
https://mysite.cchifirm.ca/taxcan/api/partner/1.0/TF/documents/72f70b71-c5ff-444a-8911-10787851632b/printslips
Request body
{
"options": {
"mergePdf": true,
"copyToDocuments": true
},
"form": "T4",
"dataType": "Original",
"language": "English"
}
Response body
N/A
Notes:
In the firm settings, the options set on the
Customize PDF file
page, such as the PDF nomenclature, are used for printing via the Web API.
All applicable copies and slips of the document for the form named in the request will be printed.
Only the T3 and TF products are supported by this endpoint. Printing the slips using a different product will result in an error.
/api/partner/1.0/print/{resultId} (GET)
Endpoint description
This endpoint returns the result of a print action (including all returns specified in the batch). An ID must be provided in the URL, which represents the resource of the print that was completed. This ID is provided by the
Tasks endpoint
.

N/A
Properties
N/A

https://mysite.cchifirm.ca/taxcan/api/partner/1.0/print/f3eb4d73-208b-4688-a0a0-99a954b2df25
Request body
N/A
Response body
{
"result": [
{
"fileId": "78600302-da96-4714-980a-fd69898c07cc",
"validUntil": "2020-04-20T00:00:00Z",
"content": [
{
"documentId": "de857e7e-c22f-44e6-8f3d-a47d957eed42",
"returnIds": [
0,
1
]
}]

Notes:
PDF and .zip files generated by the Web API are stored on our servers for 24 hours. After this period, the files will be deleted.
